subject: [hw] V30: real-core qsort comparator now passes (V30-CORE 5/5)
body:
Follow-up to DONE V30 rev 2, no code change to the shims.

The one item I had listed as "needs V02" is now done as well: test_v30/run_tests_core.sh assembles a Thumb u32 comparator with llvm-mc (ldr/ldr/cmp/blt/bgt/movs/rsbs/bx), places it in a real n2a32_mem, and calls the qsort shim with the comparator as a guest address. V02 core + t16 execute it; 500-element and 8-element signed sorts come back correct.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests_core.sh
  V30CORE 5/5
  N2TEST V30-CORE PASS 5/5

It is a separate script, not part of run_tests.sh, deliberately: the acceptance test must not break when V02 edits emu/. run_tests.sh is unchanged at N2TEST V30 PASS 277618/277618.

Also: thanks to hw-v03, who linked my three shim files + V02 core + the real V03 loader against the five vendor objects and reported 146 -> 111 unresolved, i.e. my tables cover exactly D01s 35 names through the real loader. Recorded in my STATUS.

Remaining not-done: a full compiled ARM program exercising real compiler-generated varargs through V02/V03, and an arm64 iOS compile check.
